name: AdisInsight
description: AdisInsight gives Claude real-time access to the world's most comprehensive pharmaceutical drug and clinical trial intelligence database, powered by Springer Nature. Search and explore drug pipelines by developer, therapeutic area, development phase, mechanism of action, and 40+ parameters. Find clinical trials by compound, sponsor, indication, phase, and status. Analyze competitive landscapes by company portfolios. Generate interactive charts visualizing pipeline distributions and trial landscapes. Access detailed drug profiles including development history, adverse events, and regulatory milestones.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AdisInsight to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AdisInsight to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://adisinsight-mcp.springer.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AdisInsight MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AdisInsight provides these MCP tools: search_drugs, get_drug, search_trials, get_trial, search_drug_companies, search_trial_companies, and generate_chart.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AdisInsight?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AdisInsight in life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Boltz API, Helix GenoSphere, Inductive Bio, LatchBio, and Owkin.
AdisInsight requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AdisInsight is developed by Springer Nature. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
